India Allows Private and Foreign Investment in Nuclear Sector

India has opened its nuclear sector to private and foreign players, allowing participation under strict regulations. The policy permits proven foreign technology to enter the sector, subject to stringent regulatory oversight. This move signifies a shift in India's approach to nuclear energy development, aiming to leverage external expertise and investment while maintaining control over safety and security protocols.
